report_type: UNDERLYING SIGNAL RESEARCH (SPY share prices). NOT option profitability.

assumptions.target_fill: requires trade-through by the slippage buffer

chart_exits.question: At the same dollar risk per trade, do stops and targets taken from support/resistance zones earn more than fixed ATR exits on the same entries?
chart_exits.verdict_reason: the 95% range for the per-trade difference includes zero
notes: Compared on identical entries; R is measured against each method's own stop, so both risk the same dollars per trade.
Trades with no clean chart plan are passed by the chart method; see the skip counts and the 'skips as zero' totals.
Chart zones at each entry use only candles that had closed by then.

trend_pullback.label: trend_pullback@1.0#6551a6ed

spec.name: trend_pullback
spec.hypothesis: When the 1-hour trend and 5-minute trend agree, a shallow pullback to the 21-EMA that reclaims its prior bar high tends to continue in the trend direction.
spec.conditions: 1h close above its 20-EMA with rising slope (long), 5m EMA9 > EMA21; mirrored for short.
spec.trigger: 5m bar closes above the prior bar's high after touching EMA21 within the last 6 bars, closing above EMA21 and its own open.
spec.confirmation: 1h trend must agree; price on the correct side of VWAP; ADX >= 20.
spec.invalidation: Close back through EMA21 against the trade, or 1h trend flips.
spec.targets: T1 = 1.5R (half), T2 = 3R (half, stop to breakeven after T1).
spec.time_exit: Flat at the mandatory exit time (15:45 ET) at the latest.
spec.contract_criteria: Liquid same-day SPY options, delta near 0.30-0.40, spread <= configured max. Requires verified executable quotes.
spec.risk_constraints: Max 3 trades/day, 1 concurrent, risk per trade from config.

trend_pullback.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy 0.1R, CI [-0.082, 0.274]; no reliable edge shown

orb_retest.label: orb_retest@1.0#fa99858c

spec.name: orb_retest
spec.hypothesis: A confirmed break of the first-30-minute range that retests the break level and holds tends to extend.
spec.conditions: Opening range (09:30-10:00) is complete; no signal before 10:05.
spec.trigger: Within 2-12 bars after a close beyond the range, a bar wicks back to the level (within 0.1 ATR) and closes beyond it in the break direction.
spec.confirmation: Bar closes in the break direction (green for long); 1h trend not opposed.
spec.invalidation: Close back inside the opening range.
spec.risk_constraints: Max 1 signal per direction per day.

orb_retest.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy 0.009R, CI [-0.229, 0.233]; no reliable edge shown

failed_breakout.label: failed_breakout@1.0#95a5a945

spec.name: failed_breakout
spec.hypothesis: A break of the opening range that fails and closes back inside traps late entrants and tends to reverse.
spec.conditions: Opening range complete; the break happened within the last 3 bars.
spec.trigger: A bar's high exceeded OR high (or low broke OR low) within 3 bars, and the current bar closes back inside the range with a bearish (bullish) body.
spec.confirmation: Current bar closes beyond its own midpoint toward the reversal; ADX below 30 (not a runaway trend).
spec.invalidation: A new extreme beyond the failed break.

failed_breakout.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy -0.044R, CI [-0.262, 0.182]; no reliable edge shown

range_reversion.label: range_reversion@1.0#14e675a3

spec.name: range_reversion
spec.hypothesis: In low-trend (range) conditions, a close back inside a Bollinger band after an excursion tends to revert toward the mean.
spec.trigger: Previous bar closed outside the lower (upper) band and the current bar closes back inside it with RSI < 35 (> 65) on the prior bar.
spec.confirmation: Current bar closes in the reversal direction.

range_reversion.verdict_reason: only 32 out-of-sample trades; at least 100 are required before any claim

vol_expansion.label: vol_expansion@1.0#750b320a

spec.name: vol_expansion
spec.hypothesis: A bar with abnormally large range that closes near its extreme and breaks the 20-bar high/low signals momentum that continues.
spec.trigger: Close in the top (bottom) 25% of the bar and beyond the prior 20-bar high (low).
spec.confirmation: Relative volume >= 1.0 when volume is available.

vol_expansion.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy 0.013R, CI [-0.282, 0.343]; no reliable edge shown

orb_breakout.label: orb_breakout@1.0#3726d10e

spec.name: orb_breakout
spec.hypothesis: A decisive close beyond the first-30-minute range, in the direction of the 1-hour trend, tends to extend (the published 'opening range breakout' idea; effects can fade, so it must pass the same fair test).
spec.trigger: First 5-minute close beyond the opening range high (low) of the day.
spec.confirmation: 1h trend agrees; price on the correct side of VWAP.
spec.invalidation: Close back inside the opening range.
spec.risk_constraints: Max 1 signal per direction per day.

orb_breakout.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy 0.059R, CI [-0.187, 0.337]; no reliable edge shown

vwap_reclaim.label: vwap_reclaim@1.0#151da59f

spec.name: vwap_reclaim
spec.hypothesis: In a 1-hour trend, a dip through VWAP that is reclaimed on the next close tends to resume the trend.
spec.trigger: Previous bar closed on the wrong side of VWAP; this bar closes back through it in its own direction with fast EMA beyond slow EMA.
spec.invalidation: Close back through VWAP against the trade.
spec.risk_constraints: Max 2 signals per direction per day.

vwap_reclaim.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy 0.021R, CI [-0.257, 0.299]; no reliable edge shown

gap_fade.label: gap_fade@1.0#14e675a3

spec.name: gap_fade
spec.hypothesis: After a gap of at least 0.2% from the prior close, price often drifts back toward the prior close once it starts turning that way.
spec.conditions: Opening gap >= 0.2% versus the prior close; price still on the gap side of the prior close and at least 1 ATR away from it.
spec.trigger: Before 11:30: bar closes beyond the prior bar's extreme toward the prior close, in its own direction, beyond the 9-period EMA.
spec.invalidation: Price moves a further 1 ATR away from the prior close.
spec.risk_constraints: Max 1 signal per direction per day.

gap_fade.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy 0.068R, CI [-0.193, 0.305]; no reliable edge shown

prior_day_break.label: prior_day_break@1.0#3726d10e

spec.name: prior_day_break
spec.hypothesis: A first close beyond yesterday's high (low), with the 1-hour trend behind it, tends to continue.
spec.conditions: Prior-day high and low are known.
spec.trigger: First 5-minute close of the day beyond the prior-day high (low), having been inside it on the previous close.
spec.confirmation: 1h trend agrees; price on the correct side of VWAP.
spec.invalidation: Close back inside the prior-day range.
spec.risk_constraints: Max 1 signal per direction per day.

prior_day_break.verdict_reason: only 79 out-of-sample trades; at least 100 are required before any claim

support_bounce.label: support_bounce@1.0#151da59f

spec.name: support_bounce
spec.hypothesis: In an uptrend (higher highs and higher lows) a dip back to the last higher low that is rejected tends to resume up; mirrored for resistance in a downtrend.
spec.conditions: Classic chart support/resistance. 5-minute structure and the 1-hour trend agree.
spec.trigger: A candle probes to within a quarter ATR of the last confirmed swing low (never more than one ATR beyond it) and closes back away from it in the strong part of its range.
spec.invalidation: Close beyond the swing level against the trade.
spec.risk_constraints: Max 2 signals per direction per day.

support_bounce.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy -0.014R, CI [-0.308, 0.303]; no reliable edge shown

swing_breakout.label: swing_breakout@1.0#3726d10e

spec.name: swing_breakout
spec.hypothesis: A strong close beyond the last confirmed swing high (low) on above-normal volume tends to continue.
spec.conditions: Classic breakout of resistance (support). 5-minute structure is not against the move.
spec.trigger: First close beyond the last confirmed swing high/low, in the strong part of its candle, with relative volume at least 1.2.
spec.confirmation: 1h trend agrees; price on the correct side of VWAP.
spec.invalidation: Close back inside the broken level.
spec.risk_constraints: Max 2 signals per direction per day.

swing_breakout.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy -0.116R, CI [-0.416, 0.207]; no reliable edge shown

steady_scalper.label: steady_scalper@1.0#69a10f44

spec.name: steady_scalper
spec.hypothesis: Same pullback entries as trend_pullback with a wide stop and a near target, to test what a high win rate costs.
spec.risk_constraints: Research only: blended reward:risk is below the 1.5 minimum.

steady_scalper.verdict_reason: out-of-sample net expectancy 0.01R, CI [-0.075, 0.092]; no reliable edge shown

zone_rejection.label: zone_rejection@1.0#151da59f

spec.name: zone_rejection
spec.hypothesis: A candle that probes a strong support (or resistance) zone and is rejected, while the bigger trend agrees and there is room to run, tends to reverse away from it.
spec.conditions: How chart traders actually use levels: only strong zones, only with the bigger trend, only with a rejection candle, stop behind the zone.
spec.trigger: Rejection candle (closes in the strong 40% of its range, wick at least 40% of range, range at least 0.8 ATR) with the 1-hour trend agreeing; then the chart checklist must pass: bigger trend agrees, strong zone touched, entry within 1.5 ATR of it.
spec.invalidation: Close beyond the zone against the trade.
spec.targets: Just before the next opposing zone; at least 2R of room.
spec.risk_constraints: Max 2 signals per direction per day.

zone_rejection.verdict_reason: only 12 out-of-sample trades; at least 100 are required before any claim

multiple_testing.note: Bonferroni-adjusted across strategies. Grids and ablations used train+validation only.

options_profitability_research.reason: No free source of historical SPY option bid/ask quotes was found. Alpaca's free feed is indicative, not actual quotes, and cannot support execution-realistic option backtests.
options_profitability_research.consequence: Nothing in this report shows that option trades would have been profitable.

limitations: Bootstrap CIs ignore serial correlation between trades.
Free intraday history is short; regime coverage may be poor.
IEX-only volume understates real volume; VWAP/relative volume are approximations.
Past results do not predict future results.
